evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A session notice just said ctx7 is missing. Is the ctx7 CLI installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for ctx7. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /context7:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Does not run `apply` or `npm install -g ctx7`, and downloads nothing
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/context7:check

The check failed. Just install ctx7 for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /context7:setup apply install-cli as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not run `npm install -g ctx7@latest` itself
Names /context7:setup apply install-cli as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim ctx7 is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When ctx7 or the Context7 MCP server resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /context7:setup apply
